endorsements.name: Cody Brocious (Daeken)
endorsements.label: Owning The Cloud Through Server-Side Request Forgery
endorsements.description: With how many apps are running in the cloud, hacking these instances becomes easier with a simple vulnerability due to an unsanitized user input. In this talk, we’ll discuss a number of different methods that helped us exfil data from different applications using Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). Using these methods, we were able to hack some of the major transportation, hospitality, and social media companies and make $50,000 in rewards in 3 months.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 27
